from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
audit.clear()
p = Payment("pay_1","inv_1",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
r = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00")
# idempotent replay
r2 = refund_shipping(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0, idempotency_key="k1")
assert r2 is p and p.refunded_amount == Decimal("10.00")
ev = audit.events("shipping_refunded")
assert len(ev)==1 and ev[0]["idempotency_key"]=="k1"
assert isinstance(ev[0]["amount"], Decimal), type(ev[0]["amount"])
# full refund
refund_shipping(p, Decimal("90.00"), T0)
assert p.status=="refunded" and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")
# over refund
try:
    refund_shipping(p, Decimal("1.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should fail")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="invalid_state"
# approval
audit.clear()
p2 = Payment("pay_2","inv_2",Decimal("1000.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
try:
    refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("600.00"), T0)
    raise SystemExit("should fail")
except BillingError as e:
    assert e.code=="approval_required"
refund_shipping(p2, Decimal("600.00"), T0, approved_by="mgr")
assert p2.refunded_amount==Decimal("600.00")
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF"}
